scenarios.description: Overdraft 800 € at 16 %, no fixed repayment, and a 5 % loan: agios added monthly, the overdraft is repaid first (AC-02, AC-03), then stays available at 0 € (AC-04)
Budget short by 150 € a month: the overdraft absorbs it up to its 1 000 € limit, then the shortfall is dropped (AC-09)
Overdraft at 2 % (below the 3 % threshold: never repaid early) with a 100 € fixed repayment (AC-07)
Overdraft unused at the start and a positive budget: stays at 0 €, debt-free = the loan's payoff (AC-04)
